what: Everything in Wikidata that has a flag (P41) and that at least 40 pages of Wikimedia sites tell of, by its Wikidata id: what the lists of scripts/data/flags-lists.json are made from. items: its names in Spanish and in English (es, en), how many pages tell of it (links), what it is (is: P31), the country it is in (in: P17), the years it began and ended (from, to: P571 and P576), and its flags, each with its file, its rank when it is not the usual one and the days it flew between; what the game already has says only as what (game: country, piece or city). classes: the English name of each class
